gap_report_metadata.requirement_title: As a customer, I want to browse available mobile devices, review product details and default configurations, view promotional offers and estimated delivery information, authenticate when required, and seamlessly continue my purchase journey after successful login, so that I can make an informed purchase decision and complete my mobile device purchase successfully.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC3 – Default Product Configuration (Partially Covered): When the Product Details Page is opened, the application shall: Display the default device colour. Display the default storage option. Display the default payment option. Display the correct pricing for the default configuration. Display the estimated delivery date. Display the promotional offer (if available).
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify default device configuration displays correct values for Colour, Storage, and Payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G details page
Verify default device configuration displays correct colour, storage, and payment option on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP
Verify default configuration visibility and accuracy when PDP loads with delayed hydration or async rendering
Verify default configuration visibility and correctness when PDP loads with delayed hydration or slow network
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Missing verification for: (1) Estimated delivery date display on Product Details Page - no test case explicitly validates that the estimated delivery date is displayed with correct format and value; (2) Promotional offer display (if available) on Product Details Page - no test case explicitly validates that promotional offers are displayed when available with correct offer details and messaging. Current test cases verify default colour, storage, payment option, pricing, and delayed hydration scenarios, but do not cover delivery date or promotional offer display requirements.
recommended_test_enhancements: Enhance TC658: Add test steps to verify estimated delivery date is displayed in format 'Estimated delivery: DD MMM YYYY' and promotional offer is displayed if available with correct details.
Enhance TC668: Add test steps to verify estimated delivery date display and promotional offer display (if available) on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP.
Enhance TC663: Add test steps to verify estimated delivery date and promotional offer are correctly displayed after complete page load under delayed hydration conditions.
Enhance TC673: Add test steps to verify estimated delivery date and promotional offer are correctly displayed after complete page load under slow network conditions.
Create new test case: Verify promotional offer display logic - when offer is available, it displays prominently with correct details; when not available, no promotional message is shown.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC4 – Continue Purchase Journey (Partially Covered): The customer shall be able to: View the Next button. Click the Next button. Continue to the next purchase step. Prevent duplicate submissions when the button is clicked multiple times. Resume the purchase journey after successful authentication.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify Next button is interactable and initiates the next step in purchase journey
Verify Next button initiates the next step in purchase journey
Verify Next button behavior when clicked multiple times rapidly to prevent duplicate submissions
Verify Next button behavior when clicked multiple times rapidly to prevent duplicate submissions
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Missing verification for: Resume purchase journey after successful authentication - no test case validates that after successful login, the user is redirected back to the exact interrupted purchase step (Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP with selected configuration preserved) and can continue from where they left off without re-authentication. Current test cases verify Next button visibility, click functionality, next step initiation, and duplicate submission prevention, but do not cover the critical post-authentication journey resumption scenario which is essential for seamless user experience.
recommended_test_enhancements: Enhance TC659: Add test steps to verify if login popup appears, complete login with valid credentials, verify user is redirected back to Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP, verify device configuration is preserved, and verify user can click Next again to continue without re-authentication.
Enhance TC669: Add test steps to verify post-authentication redirect back to Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP, configuration preservation, and ability to continue purchase journey without re-authentication.

Enhance TC664: Add test steps to verify if login popup appears after first click, complete login, verify redirect back to PDP, verify configuration preservation, and verify user can proceed without re-authentication.
Enhance TC674: Add test steps to verify post-authentication redirect, configuration preservation, and journey continuation without re-authentication after rapid click scenario.

Create new test case: End-to-end authentication flow - verify unauthenticated user clicks Next on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP with specific configuration (e.g., Blue colour, 512GB storage, 36-month payment), completes login, is redirected back to PDP with exact configuration preserved, and can immediately continue to next purchase step without re-selecting configuration or re-authenticating.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC5 – Authentication (Partially Covered): If the customer is not authenticated, the application shall: Display the Login popup after clicking Next. Display Login and Sign Up options. Prevent the purchase journey until authentication is completed. Redirect the customer back to the interrupted purchase step after successful login.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify login or sign-up popup is displayed with correct message and action buttons when unauthenticated user clicks Next
Verify login and sign-up popup displays with correct message and action buttons for unauthenticated user
Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains stable under timing-sensitive conditions
Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains functional across different viewport sizes
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Missing verification for: Redirect customer back to interrupted purchase step after successful login - no test case validates the complete post-authentication redirect behavior and journey resumption with preserved context. Current test cases verify login popup display, Login and Sign Up options, purchase journey prevention until authentication, popup stability under timing-sensitive conditions, and responsive popup display across viewports. However, none validate that after successful login, the system closes the popup, redirects the user back to the exact purchase step (Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP), preserves the device configuration (colour, storage, payment option), and allows the user to immediately continue the purchase journey without re-authentication or re-configuration.
recommended_test_enhancements: Enhance TC660: Add test steps to click 'Log in with Hub ID', complete login with valid credentials (test_user@starhub.com / ValidPass123), verify popup closes, verify redirect back to Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP, verify device configuration is preserved, and verify user can click Next to continue without re-authentication.
Enhance TC670: Add test steps to complete login flow, verify popup closes, verify redirect to Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP, verify configuration preservation, and verify seamless journey continuation.

Enhance TC665: Add test steps to complete login under timing-sensitive conditions, verify popup closes, verify redirect back to PDP, verify configuration preservation, and verify user can continue without re-authentication.

Enhance TC675: Add test steps across all viewport sizes (mobile, tablet, desktop) to complete login, verify popup closes, verify redirect to Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP, verify configuration preservation, and verify journey continuation without re-authentication.

Create new test case: Post-authentication context preservation - verify unauthenticated user on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP with custom configuration (e.g., Green colour, 1TB storage, 12-month payment), clicks Next, sees login popup, completes login, is redirected back to Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP, sees exact same configuration preserved (Green, 1TB, 12-month), and can immediately proceed to next step without reconfiguration.

partially_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC6 – Error Handling (Partially Covered): The application shall gracefully handle error scenarios including: Network interruption while loading pages. Device unavailability or out-of-stock condition. Slow network response while loading the Product Details Page. HTTP 500/Internal Server Error. API timeout while retrieving product details. Display appropriate error messages without crashing.
partially_mapped_criteria.gap_analysis: Missing verification for: (1) HTTP 500/Internal Server Error handling - no test case explicitly simulates HTTP 500 error when loading Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP and verifies appropriate error message is displayed without application crash; (2) API timeout while retrieving product details - no test case explicitly simulates API timeout scenario and verifies timeout error message with retry option; (3) Comprehensive error message validation across all error types - while some error scenarios are covered by test cases assigned to other ACs (TC661/TC671 for network interruption, TC662/TC672 for device unavailability, TC663/TC673 for slow network), there is no comprehensive validation that all error scenarios display user-friendly messages and maintain application stability without crash or blank screen. Note: Due to one-to-one test case ownership rule, relevant error handling test cases (TC661, TC662, TC663, TC671, TC672, TC673) were assigned to their primary functional ACs (AC1, AC2, AC3) where they provide the highest semantic match, leaving AC6 without directly mapped test cases despite partial coverage.
recommended_test_enhancements: Create new test case: HTTP 500 Error Handling - simulate HTTP 500 Internal Server Error when loading Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP, verify appropriate error message is displayed (e.g., 'We're experiencing technical difficulties. Please try again later.'), verify error message includes retry button or link, verify application does not crash or display blank screen, verify user can retry or navigate back to device listing.

Create new test case: API Timeout Handling - simulate API timeout when retrieving Samsung Galaxy A57 5G product details (e.g., set timeout to 1 second with 30-second API response), verify timeout error message is displayed (e.g., 'Request timed out. Please check your connection and try again.'), verify retry option is available, verify application remains stable without crash.

Create new test case: Comprehensive Error Message Validation - test all error scenarios (network interruption, device unavailability, slow network, HTTP 500, API timeout) and verify each displays user-friendly, actionable error messages, verify no technical error codes or stack traces are exposed to end users, verify application maintains stability and usability after each error, verify user can recover from each error scenario through retry or navigation.

Create new test case: Error Recovery Flow - verify user encounters error on Samsung Galaxy A57 5G PDP, sees appropriate error message, clicks retry button, successfully loads PDP after retry, and can continue purchase journey without data loss or configuration reset.

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC1 – Mobile Devices Listing (Fully Covered): The customer shall be able to: Navigate from the StarHub Home page to Mobile → All Phones. View the Mobile Devices listing page. Verify the page heading is displayed correctly. Verify the correct URL is loaded. View all available mobile devices.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can successfully navigate to Mobile Devices listing page from StarHub personal homepage
Verify successful navigation to All Phones listing page from StarHub homepage
Verify system behavior when user attempts to navigate to All Phones with network interruption
Verify system behavior when All Phones listing page fails to load or displays zero items

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC2 – Product Details Page (Fully Covered): The customer shall be able to: Select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G from the device listing. Navigate to the Product Details Page. Verify the product information. Verify the Product Details Page URL.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify user can select Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device from All Phones listing and navigate to device details page
Verify Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device details page displays when selected from All Phones listing
Verify system behavior when Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device is not available or out of stock on listing page
Verify error handling when Samsung Galaxy A57 5G device is unavailable or fails to load on listing page

fully_mapped_criteria.acceptance_criterion: AC7 – Responsive Authentication Popup (Fully Covered): The application shall ensure that the authentication popup: Displays correctly on Desktop. Displays correctly on Tablet. Displays correctly on Mobile. Maintains usability across supported screen resolutions.
mapped_test_case_titles: Verify authentication popup displays correctly and remains functional across different viewport sizes
